name: demoforge-self-demo
audience: engineers and security folks deciding whether to try demoforge on their own repo; shared in Slack and the README
one_thing: Point demoforge at a repo and you get a real, narrated demo film, made locally.

music.caption: Bright, driving electronic underscore with a warm analog synth arpeggio, punchy kick, crisp claps and a rising bass line. Confident and curious, builds quickly, then resolves. Modern, clean mix, no vocals.
